reviews.comment: I took Dr. Evans for 210 and 331, and will be taking 481 with her over the summer.She is the kindest,most understanding,and compassionate prof out there! 331 was group project heavy with 2 exams, and 210 was more exam heavy,but both classes were so-doable and she gave bonus points! Literally take any class you can with her while you have the chance

I took her for 331 & LOVED the class! She is such an amazing teacher, it is definitely sad to hear she is leaving! The group project was made very manageable since it was completed over the entire semester, and she was always there to help! The exams did have some questions from the textbook, but you could still do good w/out it! Totally recommend!

I will be taking as many classes with her as possible. She cares about her students, genuinely wants to know you and help you succeed. Pay attention and participate and you'll do well. Tests are open note, she gives extra credit answers in class so pay attention. Extremely approachable and understanding, one of the best professors i've had.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: TAKE HER!!! If you want a kind, generous and passionate prof, take her. She was the absolute best ever! I took her half online half in person due to COVID... but she seriously is so understanding. Attendance is mandatory, but her classes are enjoyable. This is an easy A class, if you don't get an A then I don't know what to tell you.

Professor Evans is one of the sweetest and most understanding people you will ever meet. Even during this pandemic she was so helpful with everything, and was very understanding of everyone's situations. 10/10 would recommend her!!!
